INTJ.traits_zh: 独立自信、战略思维的规划者。INTJ 天生善于从宏观角度构建框架和策略，以系统化方式拆解复杂问题。他们标准极高、不受从众心理影响，始终保有自己独立的判断标准。
INTJ.traits_en: Independent, self-assured strategists. INTJs excel at constructing frameworks and long-term plans from a big-picture perspective, decomposing complex problems with a systems mindset. They hold themselves to high standards and maintain their own judgment rather than following the crowd.
strengths_zh: 战略思维，善于长远规划
独立判断，不随波逐流
标准极高，追求持续精进
逻辑严密，善于系统性解决问题
目标明确，执行专注
strengths_en: Strategic thinking with a talent for long-range planning
Independent judgment, immune to herd mentality
High personal standards and continuous self-improvement
Rigorous logic and systematic problem solving
Clear goals with focused execution
weaknesses_zh: 过于自信，听不进反对意见
忽略人际温度，显得冷漠
对低效缺乏耐心，容易苛责他人
完美主义，容易过度打磨方案
不擅长表达情感，亲密关系疏离
weaknesses_en: Overconfident and dismissive of dissenting views
Overlooks interpersonal warmth and can seem cold
Impatient with inefficiency and quick to judge others
Perfectionism that leads to over-polishing plans
Struggles to express emotion, creating distance in close relationships
INTJ.work_style_zh: 习惯长期规划、独立攻坚，喜欢在安静无打扰的环境中高效执行，用系统和方法替代重复劳动。
INTJ.work_style_en: Prefers long-term planning and tackling hard problems independently, working in quiet, uninterrupted settings and replacing repetitive effort with systems and methods.
INTJ.decision_zh: 以逻辑和数据为唯一依据做决策，先构建完整框架再快速收敛结论，极少受情绪或他人期待影响。
INTJ.decision_en: Decides on logic and data alone, first building a complete framework and then converging rapidly on a conclusion, largely unaffected by emotion or others' expectations.
INTJ.stress_zh: 面对能力不足的合作者或反复变更的目标时容易烦躁，压力下会变得更加独断和挑剔，倾向封闭自己独自消化。
INTJ.stress_en: Becomes irritable around incompetent collaborators or constantly shifting goals; under stress they grow more autocratic and critical, tending to withdraw and process alone.
INTJ.communication_zh: 偏好简洁、有逻辑、直奔结论的沟通，欣赏展示能力和事实的对话，反感寒暄与绕弯子。
INTJ.communication_en: Prefers concise, logical, conclusion-first communication; appreciates competence and facts, and dislikes small talk or beating around the bush.
INTJ.collaboration_zh: 与 INTJ 协作要提前给出背景信息和目标，尊重其独立工作节奏，用事实和数据说服而非人情绑架。
INTJ.collaboration_en: When working with an INTJ, provide context and goals upfront, respect their independent rhythm, and persuade with facts and data rather than social pressure.

INTP.traits_zh: 好奇多思、追求真理的独立思考者。INTP 对知识和逻辑有永不满足的渴望，善于发现系统中的模式与不一致之处。他们思维灵活、知识广博，但可能沉浸在思考中而忽略行动和人际互动。
INTP.traits_en: Curious, tireless thinkers in pursuit of truth. INTPs have an insatiable appetite for knowledge and logic, and a knack for spotting patterns and inconsistencies in systems. They are mentally agile and widely knowledgeable, yet may get lost in thought at the expense of action and social engagement.
strengths_zh: 逻辑严密，分析能力极强
创新思维，善于提出新概念
独立思考，不迷信权威
善于发现模式与系统漏洞
知识面广，学习能力强
strengths_en: Airtight logic with exceptional analytical ability
Innovative mind skilled at generating new concepts
Independent thinker who does not defer to authority
Talented at spotting patterns and system flaws
Broad knowledge base and fast learning
weaknesses_zh: 想得多做得少，行动力不足
容易忽略细节和收尾工作
社交被动，不主动维系关系
兴趣发散，容易半途转移注意力
对规则和流程有天然抵触
weaknesses_en: Thinks far more than acts, with weak follow-through
Overlooks details and finishing touches
Passive socially and reluctant to maintain relationships
Scattered interests, easily diverted mid-project
Natural resistance to rules and procedures
INTP.work_style_zh: 偏好深度思考和概念验证式的工作，需要大块自主时间，讨厌被会议和琐碎流程打断。
INTP.work_style_en: Prefers deep thinking and proof-of-concept work, needs large blocks of autonomous time, and dislikes being interrupted by meetings and trivial processes.
INTP.decision_zh: 决策前会穷尽各种可能性和反例，追求逻辑上的完备，但容易因分析瘫痪而迟迟不拍板。
INTP.decision_en: Exhausts possibilities and counterexamples before deciding in pursuit of logical completeness, which can lead to analysis paralysis and delayed decisions.
INTP.stress_zh: 被迫社交或执行无意义的规则时压力陡增，压力下会变得疏离、挑剔甚至冷嘲热讽。
INTP.stress_en: Stress spikes when forced into socializing or executing meaningless rules; under pressure they become detached, critical, and even sarcastic.
INTP.communication_zh: 喜欢智识层面的探讨，欢迎有依据的质疑，需要时间消化后再回复，反感情绪化施压。
INTP.communication_en: Enjoys intellectual discussion and welcomes well-grounded challenges; needs time to digest before replying and resents emotional pressure.
INTP.collaboration_zh: 与 INTP 协作要给足思考空间和灵活安排，聚焦问题本身，把执行细节交给有耐心补位的伙伴。
INTP.collaboration_en: Give INTPs room to think and flexible arrangements, focus discussions on the problem itself, and pair them with patient partners who can fill execution gaps.

ENTJ.traits_zh: 自信果断、具备战略眼光的天生指挥者。ENTJ 善于从全局把握方向、制定策略并推动执行，对效率有近乎执着的追求。他们天然具备领导气场，但可能显得过于强势和不近人情。
ENTJ.traits_en: Bold, decisive leaders with strategic vision. ENTJs grasp direction from a whole-system view, set strategy, and drive execution with an almost obsessive focus on efficiency. They carry a natural air of command, though they can come across as domineering and impersonal.
strengths_zh: 战略视野，善于全局布局
决断力强，敢拍板担责
高效推动，执行力出众
目标明确，善于拆解路径
抗压能力强，越挫越勇
strengths_en: Strategic vision and talent for big-picture positioning
Strong decisiveness, willing to make the call and own it
High-efficiency execution and follow-through
Clear goals with skillful path decomposition
Resilient under pressure, growing stronger after setbacks
weaknesses_zh: 过于强势，容不得异议
忽略人际温度，显得冷酷
对慢节奏缺乏耐心
难以示弱，不轻易求助
工作狂倾向，容易透支自己和团队
weaknesses_en: Overbearing and intolerant of dissent
Ignores interpersonal warmth, appearing cold
Impatient with slower rhythms
Struggles to show vulnerability or ask for help
Workaholic tendencies that exhaust themselves and the team
ENTJ.work_style_zh: 以目标为导向高效推进，习惯先定战略再分工授权，喜欢节奏快、权责清晰的工作环境。
ENTJ.work_style_en: Drives work goal-first with high tempo, setting strategy then delegating with clear accountability, thriving in fast-paced environments with distinct ownership.
ENTJ.decision_zh: 快速收集关键信息后果断决策，容忍一定试错成本，偏好用行动验证而非无限论证。
ENTJ.decision_en: Gathers key information quickly and decides decisively, tolerates a degree of trial-and-error, and prefers validating through action over endless deliberation.
ENTJ.stress_zh: 面对无能、拖延或组织内耗时易怒，压力下控制欲增强，容易对下属发号施令。
ENTJ.stress_en: Becomes angry when facing incompetence, procrastination, or organizational friction; under stress their need for control intensifies and they tend to bark orders.
ENTJ.communication_zh: 直接、高效、不兜圈子，欣赏展示能力和结果的对话，反感冗长铺垫和模糊表态。
ENTJ.communication_en: Direct, efficient, straight to the point; values demonstrated competence and results, and dislikes lengthy preamble or vague hedging.
ENTJ.collaboration_zh: 与 ENTJ 协作要带着方案和结论去沟通，直接表达不同意见但给出依据，避免拖延和情绪化对抗。
ENTJ.collaboration_en: Bring options and conclusions when talking to an ENTJ, voice disagreement directly but with evidence, and avoid procrastination or emotional confrontation.

ENTP.traits_zh: 机智灵活、勇于挑战的创新者。ENTP 享受智识碰撞和辩论，善于从多角度看问题并发现系统漏洞。他们思维敏捷、口才出色，勇于挑战权威和现状，是天然的魔鬼代言人。
ENTP.traits_en: Quick-witted, provocative innovators. ENTPs relish intellectual sparring and debate, viewing problems from many angles and exposing flaws in any system. With agile minds and sharp rhetoric, they readily challenge authority and the status quo as natural devil's advocates.
strengths_zh: 创新思维，点子层出不穷
善于辩论和说服，口才出色
多视角分析，快速抓住问题本质
适应力强，不怕从零开始
敢于挑战假设，打破思维定式
strengths_en: Endlessly inventive idea generators
Skilled debaters and persuaders with sharp rhetoric
Multi-angle analysis that cuts to the essence fast
Highly adaptable, unfazed by starting from scratch
Challenges assumptions and breaks mental ruts
weaknesses_zh: 好胜心强，争论过多伤和气
执行虎头蛇尾，容易半途弃坑
注意力分散，同时开太多战线
忽略他人情绪，言辞过于犀利
反感例行事务，细节管理薄弱
weaknesses_en: Overly competitive, arguing at the cost of harmony
Strong starts but weak finishes, prone to abandoning projects
Scattered attention across too many fronts
Disregards others' feelings with overly sharp words
Averse to routine work and weak on detail management
ENTP.work_style_zh: 热衷概念创新和挑战假设，节奏快、迭代快，讨厌一成不变的流程和重复劳动。
ENTP.work_style_en: Energized by concept innovation and challenging assumptions, working in fast iterations, and allergic to rigid processes and repetitive chores.
ENTP.decision_zh: 依赖快速的多角度推演和直觉跳跃，先提出大胆假设再边验证边修正，敢于冒险试错。
ENTP.decision_en: Relies on rapid multi-angle reasoning and intuitive leaps, proposing bold hypotheses first and refining while testing, comfortable with risky experimentation.
ENTP.stress_zh: 被迫执行细节工作或遵守僵化规则时感到窒息，压力下变得争强好胜、讥讽挖苦。
ENTP.stress_en: Feels suffocated when forced into detail work or rigid rules; under stress they turn combative and sarcastic.
ENTP.communication_zh: 喜欢观点交锋式的讨论，欢迎被挑战也乐于挑战，沟通跳跃发散，需要有人帮忙收敛。
ENTP.communication_en: Enjoys idea sparring, welcomes challenges as much as they dish them out; communication is leaping and divergent, benefiting from someone who helps converge.
ENTP.collaboration_zh: 与 ENTP 协作要不惧辩论、就事论事，把发散讨论记下来再结构化收敛，执行环节引入靠谱的落地伙伴。
ENTP.collaboration_en: Don't shy from debating an ENTP and keep it about the issue; capture divergent ideas then converge structurally, and bring reliable executors for implementation.

INFJ.traits_zh: 深邃洞察、理想驱动的远见者。INFJ 拥有强烈的直觉和对人性的深刻理解，追求有意义的事业。他们对自己和他人都有很高期望，内心热情但外表沉静，是较为少见的类型。
INFJ.traits_en: Insightful, ideal-driven visionaries. INFJs possess strong intuition and a profound grasp of human nature, and seek out meaningful work. They hold high expectations for themselves and others—outwardly calm yet inwardly passionate—and are among the rarer types.
strengths_zh: 洞察力强，善于看透本质
有远见，擅长长远规划
富有同理心，深刻理解他人
坚持信念，原则性强
文字表达细腻有感染力
strengths_en: Deep insight that sees through to the essence
Visionary with a gift for long-term planning
Empathetic with a profound understanding of people
Steadfast in conviction and principle
Delicate, moving written expression
weaknesses_zh: 过度理想化，容易失望
共情过载，容易情绪倦怠
难以妥协，原则问题上很固执
完美主义，反复打磨不放
习惯压抑情绪，不轻易求助
weaknesses_en: Over-idealizes, setting up disappointment
Empathy overload leading to emotional burnout
Struggles to compromise and stubborn on principles
Perfectionism with endless polishing
Suppresses emotions and rarely asks for help
INFJ.work_style_zh: 使命驱动，偏好深度思考和有意义的创造性工作，需要独处时间充电，讨厌浮于表面的应付。
INFJ.work_style_en: Mission-driven, favoring deep thinking and meaningful creative work; needs solitude to recharge and dislikes superficial busywork.
INFJ.decision_zh: 综合理性分析与内在价值直觉做决策，关注决策对他人的影响，速度不快但方向坚定。
INFJ.decision_en: Blends rational analysis with inner value-driven intuition, weighs the impact on people, and decides slowly but with unwavering direction.
INFJ.stress_zh: 长期处于冲突环境或意义缺失的工作中会明显倦怠，压力下变得沉默退缩，或突然爆发激烈情绪。
INFJ.stress_en: Burns out in prolonged conflict or meaningless work; under stress they withdraw into silence or suddenly erupt with intense emotion.
INFJ.communication_zh: 偏好一对一的深度交流，喜欢讨论愿景、价值和意义，尊重其独处需求。
INFJ.communication_en: Prefers one-on-one deep conversation about vision, values, and meaning; respect their need for solitude.
INFJ.collaboration_zh: 与 INFJ 协作要建立信任和共同愿景，给予真诚反馈，避免当众施压或用琐碎事务消耗其精力。
INFJ.collaboration_en: Build trust and a shared vision when collaborating with an INFJ, offer sincere feedback, and avoid public pressure or draining them with trivia.

INFP.traits_zh: 理想主义、富有创意的追梦者。INFP 内心有一套坚定的价值体系，追求真实和意义。他们想象力丰富、共情力强，善于理解不同立场，常是团队中的精神调和者。
INFP.traits_en: Idealistic, creative dreamers. INFPs hold a firm internal value system and pursue authenticity and meaning. Rich in imagination and empathy, they understand differing viewpoints and often act as the team's quiet peacemaker.
strengths_zh: 创意丰富，想象力出众
共情力强，理解不同立场
价值导向，忠于内心信念
文字功底好，表达细腻
开放包容，善于调和分歧
strengths_en: Abundant creativity and imagination
Strong empathy that grasps multiple perspectives
Value-driven and loyal to inner convictions
Excellent writing with nuanced expression
Open-minded and skilled at mediating differences
weaknesses_zh: 过于理想化，容易失望受挫
执行力弱，落地环节乏力
回避冲突，不敢直面矛盾
自我批评严苛，容易内耗
对批评敏感，情绪易波动
weaknesses_en: Over-idealistic and easily disillusioned
Weak execution and difficulty finishing
Conflict-averse, avoids confrontation
Harsh self-criticism and internal friction
Sensitive to criticism with fluctuating moods
INFP.work_style_zh: 使命和兴趣驱动，偏好独立、有创作空间的自由节奏，需要意义感才能持续投入。
INFP.work_style_en: Driven by mission and interest; prefers an independent, self-paced rhythm with room for creation, and needs a sense of purpose to stay engaged.
INFP.decision_zh: 以个人价值观为核心做决策，反复权衡对人和事的意义，速度偏慢，但在原则问题上寸步不让。
INFP.decision_en: Decides through the lens of personal values, weighing what matters for people and purpose; somewhat slow, yet immovable on matters of principle.
INFP.stress_zh: 面对冲突、被否定价值或被迫做违心事时压力最大，压力下自我怀疑加深，容易逃避和拖延。
INFP.stress_en: Most stressed by conflict, having their values dismissed, or doing things against their conscience; under stress self-doubt deepens into avoidance and procrastination.
INFP.communication_zh: 偏好温和真诚的交流，喜欢讨论价值和意义，需要被认可，反感被命令和贴标签。
INFP.communication_en: Prefers gentle, sincere exchanges about values and meaning, needs acknowledgment, and dislikes being ordered around or labeled.
INFP.collaboration_zh: 与 INFP 协作要多给予认可和空间，把目标与其价值挂钩，冲突场景由第三方缓冲会更顺畅。
INFP.collaboration_en: Offer recognition and space when working with an INFP, link goals to their values, and use a neutral buffer in conflict situations.

ENFJ.traits_zh: 有远见、善于激励的天生领袖。ENFJ 对人有强大的感召力，善于发现每个人的潜力并激发其成长。他们理想主义与务实并存，既能描绘愿景也能推动执行。
ENFJ.traits_en: Charismatic, inspiring natural leaders. ENFJs exert a powerful influence on people, spotting each person's potential and drawing it out. They blend idealism with pragmatism, painting visions while driving execution.
strengths_zh: 感召力强，善于凝聚人心
善于发现和发展人才
有远见，能描绘动人愿景
推动力强，把愿景变成行动
沟通出色，擅长化解矛盾
strengths_en: Magnetic presence that unites people
Skilled at spotting and developing talent
Visionary who paints compelling futures
Strong drive that turns vision into action
Excellent communicator and peacemaker
weaknesses_zh: 过度关注他人，忽略自身需求
自我消耗，容易身心透支
理想化，对人性预期过高
控制欲强，容易越界代劳
难以接受批评，把异议当否定
weaknesses_en: Overly focused on others while neglecting self-care
Self-sacrificing to the point of burnout
Idealizes people and expects too much
Controlling tendencies, prone to overstepping
Takes criticism personally, hearing dissent as rejection
ENFJ.work_style_zh: 以人和使命为轴心组织工作，擅长搭建协作网络并赋能他人，节奏上既能规划也能灵活应变。
ENFJ.work_style_en: Organizes work around people and mission, building collaboration networks and empowering others; equally capable of planning and adapting.
ENFJ.decision_zh: 决策时综合团队感受与长远价值，善于在共识中推进，有时会为照顾关系而牺牲效率。
ENFJ.decision_en: Weighs team sentiment and long-term values when deciding, advancing through consensus—sometimes sacrificing efficiency for relationships.
ENFJ.stress_zh: 所带的人不领情或团队关系破裂时压力最大，压力下自我苛责，甚至迁怒或过度说教。
ENFJ.stress_en: Most stressed when their efforts go unappreciated or team bonds fracture; under stress they turn self-blaming, or become preachy and resentful.
ENFJ.communication_zh: 热情、有感染力的表达者，喜欢讨论人和愿景，需要情感回应和真诚互动。
ENFJ.communication_en: A warm, infectious communicator who loves discussing people and vision, and needs emotional responsiveness and genuine engagement.
ENFJ.collaboration_zh: 与 ENFJ 协作要真诚回应其热情，直接说明困难而不敷衍，同时提醒其关注自身边界。
ENFJ.collaboration_en: Respond genuinely to an ENFJ's enthusiasm, state difficulties frankly rather than brushing them off, and remind them to mind their own boundaries.

ENFP.traits_zh: 热情洋溢、充满创意的探索者。ENFP 对可能性和新想法有无尽热情，善于连接看似无关的概念并激发他人。他们思维发散、表达生动，是天然的创意引擎和激励者。
ENFP.traits_en: Enthusiastic, creative explorers. ENFPs bring boundless energy to possibilities and new ideas, linking seemingly unrelated concepts and igniting others. Divergent thinkers with vivid expression, they are natural creative engines and motivators.
strengths_zh: 创意无限，善于跨界连接
善于激励他人，带动团队情绪
适应性强，喜欢拥抱变化
视野开阔，能看到多种可能
真诚热情，人缘极佳
strengths_en: Endless creativity and cross-domain connections
Inspires others and lifts team morale
Highly adaptable and embraces change
Broad vision that sees many possibilities
Warm and genuine, with great rapport
weaknesses_zh: 想法难收敛，焦点容易漂移
执行不持续，虎头蛇尾
过度承诺，接太多事情
忽略细节和收尾工作
情绪起伏影响状态稳定
weaknesses_en: Struggles to converge ideas, focus drifts
Inconsistent execution, strong starts weak ends
Overcommits and takes on too much
Overlooks details and finishing touches
Emotional ups and downs affect consistency
ENFP.work_style_zh: 以头脑风暴和资源连接见长，喜欢新鲜多变的任务，讨厌重复流程和条条框框。
ENFP.work_style_en: Excels at brainstorming and connecting resources, thrives on fresh and varied tasks, and tires of repetitive processes and red tape.
ENFP.decision_zh: 凭直觉快速探索多个选项，跟着热情走，决策快但容易反复，需要外部机制帮其收敛。
ENFP.decision_en: Explores options quickly by intuition and follows their enthusiasm; decides fast but tends to revisit, benefiting from external mechanisms to converge.
ENFP.stress_zh: 被琐事和重复劳动困住或感觉失去自由时压力最大，压力下情绪波动加剧，容易焦虑逃避。
ENFP.stress_en: Most stressed when trapped in trivial routines or feeling a loss of freedom; under stress mood swings intensify into anxiety and avoidance.
ENFP.communication_zh: 热情生动、感染力强的沟通者，喜欢聊可能性和愿景，反感说教和过度管控。
ENFP.communication_en: A vivid, infectious communicator who loves discussing possibilities and visions, and resents lecturing or micromanagement.
ENFP.collaboration_zh: 与 ENFP 协作要给其探索空间，用有趣的目标激发投入，并配套明确节点和落地搭档。
ENFP.collaboration_en: Give ENFPs room to explore and motivate them with engaging goals, while pairing clear milestones with grounded partners for delivery.

ISTJ.traits_zh: 务实严谨、可靠负责的执行者。ISTJ 注重事实和细节，做事有条不紊，遵循规则和承诺。他们内心世界丰富但不轻易表露，在团队中是最可靠的支柱，言出必行。
ISTJ.traits_en: Practical, meticulous, and dependable executors. ISTJs focus on facts and details, work in an orderly manner, and honor rules and commitments. Though inwardly rich, they rarely show it; in teams they are the most reliable pillar, true to their word.
strengths_zh: 可靠稳重，言出必行
注重细节，准确度高
逻辑清晰，事实导向
执行力强，按期交付
责任心强，恪守承诺
strengths_en: Dependable and steady, always keeping their word
Detail-oriented with high accuracy
Clear, fact-based logic
Strong execution and on-time delivery
Deep sense of responsibility and follow-through
weaknesses_zh: 过于僵化，不善变通
抗拒变革，倾向守成
忽略他人感受，直言伤人
对新方法持怀疑态度
压力下独自硬扛，不求助
weaknesses_en: Rigid and inflexible
Resistant to change, inclined toward tradition
Overlooks feelings, bluntness can hurt
Skeptical of untested methods
Grinds through stress alone rather than asking for help
ISTJ.work_style_zh: 系统化推进、文档完善、按期交付，偏好职责清晰、流程稳定的工作环境。
ISTJ.work_style_en: Systematic progress, thorough documentation, and punctual delivery; prefers clear responsibilities and stable processes.
ISTJ.decision_zh: 基于事实、经验数据和先例做审慎决策，不轻信未经验证的新方案，宁可慢也要稳。
ISTJ.decision_en: Decides carefully on facts, experience, and precedent, distrusting unverified novelty—slow and steady over fast and risky.
ISTJ.stress_zh: 面对频繁变更、规则被无视或职责模糊时倍感压力，压力下变得更加固执和焦虑。
ISTJ.stress_en: Stressed by constant changes, disregarded rules, or ambiguous responsibilities; under pressure they grow more stubborn and anxious.
ISTJ.communication_zh: 偏好明确、具体、有据可依的沟通，用数据和时间线说话，反感含糊其辞和临时起意。
ISTJ.communication_en: Prefers clear, concrete, evidence-based communication with data and timelines, and dislikes vagueness or last-minute changes.
ISTJ.collaboration_zh: 与 ISTJ 协作要给出明确期望和时间线，变更提前打招呼并说明理由，认可其稳定的付出。
ISTJ.collaboration_en: Set clear expectations and timelines with an ISTJ, flag changes early with reasons, and acknowledge their steady contributions.

ISFJ.traits_zh: 温暖细腻、默默奉献的照顾者。ISFJ 观察力敏锐、记性极好，善于捕捉他人需求并主动提供帮助。他们忠诚可靠、重视和谐关系，愿意为团队付出而不求回报。
ISFJ.traits_en: Warm, attentive, quietly devoted caregivers. ISFJs are observant with excellent memory, quick to notice others' needs and step in to help. Loyal and reliable, they prize harmonious relationships and give to the team without seeking credit.
strengths_zh: 细心体贴，善于察觉需求
执行力强，默默把事做成
忠诚可靠，值得托付
实际务实，注重落地细节
耐心友善，团队润滑剂
strengths_en: Attentive and perceptive of others' needs
Strong quiet execution that gets things done
Loyal, reliable, and trustworthy
Practical and grounded in details
Patient and kind, a natural team lubricant
weaknesses_zh: 过度承担，不善拒绝
回避冲突，压抑不满
抵触变化，偏好熟悉环境
过于谦逊，成果被埋没
把批评放在心上，容易内伤
weaknesses_en: Overcommits and can't say no
Avoids conflict and bottles up grievances
Resists change, prefers the familiar
Overly modest, letting achievements go unnoticed
Takes criticism to heart and internalizes hurt
ISFJ.work_style_zh: 稳步推进、注重细节、默默维护团队氛围，喜欢有清晰指导和确定性的任务。
ISFJ.work_style_en: Steady progress, careful attention to detail, and quiet maintenance of team morale; enjoys tasks with clear guidance and certainty.
ISFJ.decision_zh: 以过往经验和对他人的实际影响为依据做务实决策，偏好稳健方案，回避激进选择。
ISFJ.decision_en: Decides pragmatically based on past experience and real impact on people, favoring safe options over bold gambles.
ISFJ.stress_zh: 被过度消耗、付出不被看见或突然施压时压力最大，压力下情绪积压后可能爆发或消极退缩。
ISFJ.stress_en: Most stressed by being overdrawn, unacknowledged, or sudden pressure; accumulated strain may erupt or turn into passive withdrawal.
ISFJ.communication_zh: 偏好温和、有认可感的交流，循序渐进引入变化，避免当众批评和突然施压。
ISFJ.communication_en: Prefers gentle, appreciative exchanges; introduce change gradually and avoid public criticism or abrupt pressure.
ISFJ.collaboration_zh: 与 ISFJ 协作要明确表达感谢、公平分担任务，主动询问其真实想法，别让付出变成理所当然。
ISFJ.collaboration_en: Express gratitude explicitly, share tasks fairly, and proactively ask an ISFJ's real opinion—never take their giving for granted.

ESTJ.traits_zh: 果断高效、组织力强的管理者。ESTJ 是天生的秩序维护者，善于建立系统和流程以确保高效运转。他们做事雷厉风行、标准明确，是团队中的定海神针。
ESTJ.traits_en: Decisive, efficient, highly organized managers. ESTJs are natural guardians of order, building systems and processes to keep things running smoothly. Fast-moving with clear standards, they are the stabilizing anchor of a team.
strengths_zh: 组织力强，善于搭建流程
执行高效，说到做到
标准明确，赏罚分明
责任心强，敢于担责
务实稳健，值得信赖
strengths_en: Strong organizational skill in building processes
Efficient execution that delivers on promises
Clear standards and fair accountability
Strong sense of responsibility and ownership
Pragmatic, steady, and trustworthy
weaknesses_zh: 过于强势，不容置疑
缺乏弹性，拘泥于流程
忽略情感因素，显得强硬
不善倾听，急于下结论
对新做法接受度低
weaknesses_en: Overbearing and intolerant of challenge
Inflexible, stuck on procedure
Discounts emotional factors and seems harsh
Poor listener, jumps to conclusions
Low acceptance of unproven approaches
ESTJ.work_style_zh: 制定流程、明确分工、结果导向，喜欢结构清晰、权责分明的组织化环境。
ESTJ.work_style_en: Sets processes, clarifies roles, and drives for results, thriving in well-structured environments with clear ownership.
ESTJ.decision_zh: 以事实、数据和既定标准快速做决策，偏好经过验证的成熟方案，决策后坚定推进。
ESTJ.decision_en: Decides quickly on facts, data, and established standards, prefers proven solutions, and pushes forward firmly once decided.
ESTJ.stress_zh: 面对混乱、无序或下属阳奉阴违时压力最大，压力下更加强硬急躁，容易越级插手。
ESTJ.stress_en: Most stressed by chaos, disorder, or half-hearted compliance; under stress they become tougher and more impatient, prone to micromanaging.
ESTJ.communication_zh: 直接、明确、任务式的沟通，用事实和数据说话，期待对方尊重其决定并按约定执行。
ESTJ.communication_en: Direct, explicit, task-focused communication grounded in facts and data, expecting respect for decisions and follow-through on agreements.
ESTJ.collaboration_zh: 与 ESTJ 协作要准时、守信、备好数据，有异议私下用事实沟通，在执行层面给足确定性。
ESTJ.collaboration_en: Be punctual, keep your word, and bring data when working with an ESTJ; raise disagreements privately with facts and provide certainty in execution.

ESFJ.traits_zh: 热心助人、组织力强的和谐维护者。ESFJ 关注他人的需求和感受，善于营造和谐的团队氛围。他们乐于助人、责任心强，是团队凝聚力的重要来源，重视传统和稳定。
ESFJ.traits_en: Warm-hearted, well-organized harmonizers. ESFJs attend closely to others' needs and feelings, cultivating a pleasant team atmosphere. Helpful and responsible, they are a key source of team cohesion and value tradition and stability.
strengths_zh: 关怀他人，天生热心肠
组织力强，擅长张罗协调
忠诚负责，有始有终
善于营造和谐的团队氛围
务实可靠，注重他人体验
strengths_en: Caring with a natural warmth for people
Strong organizers skilled at coordinating
Loyal, responsible, and thorough
Excellent at fostering team harmony
Practical and reliable, attentive to others' experience
weaknesses_zh: 过度在意他人评价，寻求认同
不善拒绝，容易被利用
抗拒变革，偏好熟悉方式
回避冲突，粉饰矛盾
声誉受损时情绪波动大
weaknesses_en: Overly concerned with others' approval
Can't refuse easily and risks being taken advantage of
Resists change, prefers familiar ways
Conflict-avoidant, papers over tensions
Emotionally rocked when their reputation is questioned
ESFJ.work_style_zh: 在维护关系的同时把执行做扎实，喜欢有明确标准和稳定节奏的协作型环境。
ESFJ.work_style_en: Delivers solid execution while tending relationships, thriving in collaborative settings with clear standards and a steady rhythm.
ESFJ.decision_zh: 优先考虑对身边人的影响和集体共识做决策，偏好稳妥方案，需要被信任的人认可后才安心。
ESFJ.decision_en: Decides primarily by impact on people and group consensus, favors safe options, and feels settled once trusted voices approve.
ESFJ.stress_zh: 被孤立、不被感激或团队关系紧张时压力最大，压力下容易自怜和抱怨，或过度卷入他人事务。
ESFJ.stress_en: Most stressed by isolation, ingratitude, or team tension; under stress they may fall into self-pity and complaint, or over-involve themselves in others' affairs.
ESFJ.communication_zh: 亲和热情的沟通者，重视认可与感谢，喜欢面对面交流，反感冷冰冰的纯任务式对话。
ESFJ.communication_en: A warm, approachable communicator who values recognition and gratitude, favors face-to-face talks, and dislikes cold, purely transactional exchanges.
ESFJ.collaboration_zh: 与 ESFJ 协作要及时表达感谢、给予明确反馈，引入变化时耐心解释理由并留出适应时间。
ESFJ.collaboration_en: Thank ESFJs promptly and give clear feedback; when introducing change, explain the reasons patiently and allow adaptation time.

ISTP.traits_zh: 冷静灵活、动手能力强的问题解决者。ISTP 善于在实践中学习，对机械原理和系统运作有天然理解力。他们沉着应对危机，喜欢拆解问题找到根因，不被规则和条框束缚。
ISTP.traits_en: Calm, adaptable hands-on problem solvers. ISTPs learn by doing, with an innate grasp of how machines and systems work. Composed in a crisis, they enjoy dissecting problems to the root cause and refuse to be boxed in by rules.
strengths_zh: 冷静理性，临危不乱
动手能力强，实践出真知
适应力好，随机应变
善于排障，直击问题根因
专注高效，行动果断
strengths_en: Calm and rational, unshaken in a crisis
Strong hands-on skill, learning by doing
Adaptable and quick to adjust on the fly
Skilled troubleshooter that strikes the root cause
Focused, efficient, and decisive in action
weaknesses_zh: 情感表达少，显得疏离
长期规划意识弱
容易感到无聊，缺乏坚持
不爱承诺，回避长期绑定
对他人情绪反应迟钝
weaknesses_en: Sparse emotional expression, seeming distant
Weak long-term planning
Bored easily, lacking persistence
Reluctant to commit, avoids long-term binds
Slow to pick up on others' emotions
ISTP.work_style_zh: 动手实验、独立排查、快速响应，偏好自由灵活、少开会少汇报的工作方式。
ISTP.work_style_en: Hands-on experimentation, independent debugging, and rapid response; prefers freedom and flexibility with minimal meetings and reporting.
ISTP.decision_zh: 依赖当下的实感和即时分析做快速决策，先动手试再修正，反感纸上谈兵式的反复论证。
ISTP.decision_en: Decides fast from real-time sensory input and immediate analysis—try first, fix later—and dislikes armchair deliberation.
ISTP.stress_zh: 被微观管理或困于流程和会议时压力最大，压力下会抽身逃避、冷处理，甚至突然消失处理自己的事。
ISTP.stress_en: Most stressed by micromanagement or being stuck in process and meetings; under stress they disengage, go cold, or quietly vanish to do their own thing.
ISTP.communication_zh: 偏好简短直接、强调实用价值的沟通，给足个人空间，反感唠叨和情感绑架。
ISTP.communication_en: Prefers brief, direct communication emphasizing practical value, wants personal space, and resents nagging or emotional pressure.
ISTP.collaboration_zh: 与 ISTP 协作要给清晰问题清单和自主权，用结果而非过程考核，紧急事务直接说事实即可。
ISTP.collaboration_en: Give ISTPs a clear problem list and autonomy, judge by results rather than process, and state plain facts when something is urgent.

ISFP.traits_zh: 温和敏感、追求自由的艺术灵魂。ISFP 活在当下，对美和和谐有天然鉴赏力。他们不喜欢冲突和规则约束，偏好用行动而非语言表达关怀，对自己在意的事有强烈的价值坚守。
ISFP.traits_en: Gentle, sensitive, free-spirited artistic souls. ISFPs live in the present with a natural eye for beauty and harmony. Averse to conflict and constraints, they express care through action rather than words, yet hold firm values about what matters to them.
strengths_zh: 审美敏锐，品味出众
善解人意，温和包容
灵活适应，随机应变
专注当下，执行力踏实
用行动表达关切，真诚可靠
strengths_en: Keen aesthetic sense and refined taste
Understanding, gentle, and accepting
Flexible and adaptable in the moment
Present-focused with grounded execution
Shows care through action, sincerely and reliably
weaknesses_zh: 回避冲突，不敢表达异议
缺乏长远规划，走一步看一步
不善表达自身需求
过于敏感，容易受伤害
抗拒结构化管理和约束
weaknesses_en: Avoids conflict, hesitant to voice disagreement
Little long-term planning, takes life step by step
Struggles to articulate personal needs
Overly sensitive and easily hurt
Resists structured management and constraints
ISFP.work_style_zh: 追求品质和体验，灵活应变不拘一格，偏好有创作自由、节奏自主的工作。
ISFP.work_style_en: Pursues quality and experience, adapts flexibly without rigid patterns, and prefers work with creative freedom and self-set pace.
ISFP.decision_zh: 以当下的感受和内在价值观为准做决策，凭手感行动，不喜欢被条条框框推着走。
ISFP.decision_en: Decides by present feelings and inner values, acting on instinct rather than being pushed along by frameworks.
ISFP.stress_zh: 被过度管控、卷入冲突或被迫违背本心时压力最大，压力下情绪低落、消极逃避，甚至突然离开。
ISFP.stress_en: Most stressed by tight control, conflict, or acting against conscience; under stress they sink into low moods, withdraw passively, or abruptly walk away.
ISFP.communication_zh: 偏好轻松非正式的交流，尊重其节奏和空间，避免当众点名和过度施压。
ISFP.communication_en: Prefers relaxed, informal exchanges; respect their rhythm and space, and avoid public call-outs or excessive pressure.
ISFP.collaboration_zh: 与 ISFP 协作要给创作空间和温和反馈，私下沟通问题，用共同认可的目标而非硬性指令驱动。
ISFP.collaboration_en: Provide creative space and gentle feedback, raise issues privately, and motivate an ISFP through shared goals rather than rigid directives.

ESTP.traits_zh: 精力充沛、果断灵活的行动派。ESTP 活在当下，善于捕捉环境中的机会并迅速行动。他们说话直接、观察敏锐，擅长在压力下做决策，喜欢冒险和挑战，厌烦重复和理论化的工作。
ESTP.traits_en: Energetic, perceptive, decisive doers. ESTPs live in the moment, spotting opportunities in their environment and acting immediately. Direct in speech and sharp in observation, they decide well under pressure, love risk and challenge, and grow bored with repetition and theory.
strengths_zh: 行动力强，说干就干
观察敏锐，善于捕捉机会
果断务实，抗压决策
善于应变，危机中表现突出
谈判与社交能力出色
strengths_en: Powerful drive to act without hesitation
Keen observer quick to seize opportunities
Decisive and pragmatic under pressure
Highly adaptable, excelling in crises
Outstanding negotiation and social skills
weaknesses_zh: 缺乏耐心，容易急躁冒进
忽略长远规划，重当下轻未来
过于冒险，低估风险
不善容忍慢节奏和细节
直言快语，容易无意伤人
weaknesses_en: Impatient, prone to rushing in
Neglects long-term planning for the here and now
Over-risky, underestimating dangers
Little tolerance for slow pace and details
Blunt speech that unintentionally wounds
ESTP.work_style_zh: 快速行动、灵活应对、结果导向，偏好充满变化、能直接看到反馈的一线场景。
ESTP.work_style_en: Fast action, flexible response, and results orientation; prefers dynamic front-line settings with immediate feedback.
ESTP.decision_zh: 基于现场实感和即时判断快速拍板，先行动再调整，敢于承担试错成本。
ESTP.decision_en: Decides rapidly from on-the-spot observation and instinct—act first, adjust later—willing to bear trial-and-error costs.
ESTP.stress_zh: 被困在理论、会议和缓慢流程中时压力最大，压力下变得鲁莽冲动、容易与人正面冲突。
ESTP.stress_en: Most stressed when trapped in theory, meetings, and slow processes; under stress they turn rash and impulsive, prone to head-on clashes.
ESTP.communication_zh: 简洁直接、聚焦当下的沟通风格，喜欢边干边聊，反感绕弯子和纸上谈兵。
ESTP.communication_en: Concise, direct, present-focused communication; prefers talking while doing and dislikes detours or armchair theorizing.
ESTP.collaboration_zh: 与 ESTP 协作要给出明确目标和授权，快节奏推进，配一位关注细节和风险的伙伴把关。
ESTP.collaboration_en: Set clear goals and grant authority when working with an ESTP, move at a fast pace, and pair them with a detail- and risk-minded partner.

ESFP.traits_zh: 热情开朗、活力四射的社交达人。ESFP 是天生的乐观主义者，善于营造愉快氛围并带动团队能量。他们享受当下的生活，对人充满热情，重视实际体验胜过抽象理论。
ESFP.traits_en: Warm, open, effervescent social spirits. ESFPs are born optimists, skilled at creating a joyful atmosphere and energizing the team. They savor life in the present, radiate warmth toward people, and prize hands-on experience over abstract theory.
strengths_zh: 亲和力强，自来熟
乐观积极，感染力强
善于沟通，表达生动
活力带动，团队气氛担当
观察敏锐，善解人意
strengths_en: Highly approachable and instantly likable
Optimistic energy that's contagious
Expressive, engaging communicator
Team morale engine full of vitality
Perceptive and attentive to people
weaknesses_zh: 容易分心，专注度不足
规划薄弱，缺乏长远视角
回避严肃和冲突话题
过于乐观，低估风险
情绪化消费与冲动决策
weaknesses_en: Easily distracted with weak focus
Poor planning and long-term vision
Avoids serious or conflict-laden topics
Overly optimistic, underestimating risks
Impulsive decisions and emotional spending
ESFP.work_style_zh: 氛围驱动、即兴发挥、人际链接，偏好多变有趣、能与人打交道的工作。
ESFP.work_style_en: Vibe-driven, improvisational, and people-connecting; prefers varied, fun work that involves interacting with others.
ESFP.decision_zh: 凭当下感受和直观体验快速决定，重人情与现场气氛，容易受环境影响改变主意。
ESFP.decision_en: Decides quickly by present feelings and direct experience, weighing relationships and atmosphere, and can be swayed by the environment.
ESFP.stress_zh: 长期独处、被负面情绪包围或缺乏认可时压力最大，压力下变得焦虑、消极或过度寻求关注。
ESFP.stress_en: Most stressed by prolonged solitude, surrounding negativity, or lack of recognition; under stress they become anxious, downcast, or attention-seeking.
ESFP.communication_zh: 热情生动的沟通者，喜欢面对面互动和具象化目标，反感冷场和过度严肃的氛围。
ESFP.communication_en: A warm, lively communicator who enjoys face-to-face interaction and concrete goals, disliking dead air or overly grave atmospheres.
ESFP.collaboration_zh: 与 ESFP 协作要保持轻松氛围并肯定其贡献，把目标拆成具象小步骤，帮其补上规划短板。
ESFP.collaboration_en: Keep the mood light and credit their contributions, break goals into concrete small steps, and help cover ESFPs' planning gaps.
